name: DC-005 5.5/2.1 mm DC power jack, PCB mount (LaskaKit LA217012)
//: The generic DC-005 right-angle PCB jack as LaskaKit sells it, product code LA217012. The page names 'LaskaKit_cz' as the manufacturer, which means no maker; there is no datasheet, only a dimension drawing image (DC-005-dim.jpg) and photos. The listing states 'Max. zatížení: 30VDC 1A', 'Contact resistance: <=0.03Ω', 'Isolation: >=100MΩ', 5.5 mm outer / 2.1 mm inner. Read 2026-09-29 while researching the irrigation controller's 12 V inlet; LaskaKit was first in the seller order and this was its only PCB-mount jack.
//why_not: Its own listing rates it 30 VDC 1 A - half the irrigation board's load.
//pin_order: Left empty on purpose. The dimension drawing labels the three pads 3, 4 and 2 - two 3.5 x 0.8 mm slots in a row and one 3.0 x 0.8 mm slot 4.8 mm behind them - and its schematic table could not be read well enough to say which pad is the centre pin. Nothing here says which pad carries the supply; a person with the part and a meter decides.
footprint_note: No footprinter string. From the seller's drawing (read by eye): outline 13.5 mm along the plug axis in the PCB layout, 9.0 across; pads 3 and 4 as 3.5 x 0.8 mm slots at 7.5 and 11.0 mm from the front edge line, pad 2 as a 3.0 x 0.8 mm slot 4.8 mm behind that row; the same three-slot shape as the Same Sky PJ-002A family, whose KiCad generic footprint may or may not fit - not compared.

body_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the seller's drawing: 9.0 across, 14.2 along the plug axis including the front lip, 11.0 tall, Ø6.4 opening, barrel axis 6.5 mm above the board. Every placement is arranged around it and nobody has measured one.

host_requirements: Do not put more than 1 A through it: the seller's own limit, and the reason it was passed over for a 2 A rail.
Nothing enforces polarity; reverse-polarity protection after it.

max_load_current_a.note: Listing: 'Max. zatižení:30VDC 1A' (Czech page), 'Max. load: 30VDC 1A' (English page). A seller's statement, not a maker's.
max_load_current_a.why_it_matters: The one number the part was passed over on.

plug_od_mm.note: '5,5/2,1mm' in the product name; the listing says outer 5.5 mm, inner 2.1 mm.

jack_opening_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing (Ø6.4); the enclosure hole.

barrel_axis_height_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing; where the enclosure hole is centred.

rear_pad_setback_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing's PCB layout; where the third slot goes relative to the row of two.

sourcing.note: '4 Kč' s DPH, '3,30 Kč bez DPH'; 'Skladem (368 ks)'. The English page shows EUR 0.16 / 0.13. Warranty 2 years, weight 0.001 kg.
